description: Solve an equation in one unknown ("x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0", "sin(x) = 0.5") or a linear system (one equation per line). Says whether the answer is EXACT or an approximation, and over which interval it searched. Never invents a root it did not find.

equations.description: One equation, or several separated by newlines for a system

from.description: Lower bound for the numeric search

to.description: Upper bound for the numeric search

unknown.description: Which variable to solve for (guessed if omitted)

name: calc_solve
